headings.description: High-impact, geometric, brutalist grotesque for massive headlines and structural titles.
headings.usage: Use Black/900 weight for H1s. Use Light/400 for conceptual subheads. Never use Inter for headings.

body.description: Sterile, technical monospace for body copy, data points, and technical readouts.
body.usage: All body copy, labels, and system readouts.

accent.description: Signal Red. Use ONLY for critical status indicators, terminal prompts, or the singular primary CTA. Less than 1% of total UI.

rules: 99% of UI must be strictly monochrome (Black, White, Greys).
Never use pure #000000; use #050505 to avoid cheap void contrast.
Foreground text must meet 4.5:1 APCA contrast. Use text shadow over any imagery/canvas.

grids_and_layouts.container: border-collapse style layout, items with border-r border-b border-border/40.

patterns.marketing_hero: Asymmetrical layout, overlap of text and technical readouts. Use Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid.
patterns.system_proofs: High Density Grid (Mode B) for displaying system internals.

rules: Use 1px sharp borders for all containers. No rounded corners (rounded-none).
No drop shadows for depth; use border weight and scale for hierarchy.
Never center-align paragraphs. Left align to follow strict Swiss structural grids.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.textures: Heavy use of ASCII overlays, subtle noise texture, and raw HTML/SVG geometric borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid entirely. Use flat, opaque surfaces to maintain the brutalist, serious tone.

interactions: Hover states: Strict 1px border highlights, text color snapping (no fade).
Page Load: Staggered reveal of structural grids. Lines draw first, text snaps in.
Scroll: Scroll-triggered ASCII or metric counter cascades using Framer Motion.
motion.reduced_motion: All major transitions must fall back to instant appearance if prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

accessibility.contrast: APCA focused. Ensure #A1A1AA text is readable against #050505.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

components.buttons: Rectangular, zero border-radius. Minimal padding but wide. Default: transparent bg, 1px white border, white text. Hover: White bg, black text. Transition: instant or 0.1s.
components.cards: Zero padding raw container. Header block (border bottom) + content block.
components.navigation: Sticky, fixed top. Solid #050505 bg, 1px white bottom border. Mono links.

libraries: Visx: For math-heavy architectural visualisations (network graphs for AIGIS/Colanode) without D3's overhead.
react-force-graph-3d: For mapping Onyx ingest connectors or DeerFlow agent topologies.
3d_libraries.context: Keep canvas backgrounds transparent. Render using white/grey wireframes or mono-nodes. No colorful 3D blobs.

journeys.overview: Six separate destination routes with six genuinely different information architectures, pedagogies, and interaction models, synthesizing the 5 core systems (Enterprise Search, Onyx, AIGIS, Colanode, DeerFlow).

investor_venture.narrative: Prove how structural AI moats compound. Show Enterprise Search unlocking proprietary deals, Onyx scaling DD, AIGIS defending infra, Colanode proving scale, DeerFlow predicting shifts.
investor_venture.interaction_model: Macro-level dashboard. Sweeping vertical timeline mapping investment thesis over time. High-level structural diagrams.
investor_venture.visuals: Massive typography (text-6xl). 'Tetris' Bento grids showing hypothetical market expansion.

investor_strategic.narrative: Focus on Enterprise IP and Risk. Map Enterprise Search across industries, Onyx for multi-tenant data, AIGIS for strict governance, Colanode for secure M&A rooms, DeerFlow for compliant R&D.
investor_strategic.interaction_model: Blueprint views. Cross-sectional 'layers' revealing compliance and scale meters. Interactive node connections.
investor_strategic.visuals: Dense, interconnected Visx graphs. Strict horizontal bands of content.

investor_operator.thesis: Mechanism / Build Sequence / Human Boundary / Product Choices.
investor_operator.narrative: Deep dive into 'the how'. Enterprise Search for immediate value, Onyx connecting legacy tech, AIGIS for execution, Colanode for remote build, DeerFlow for automated scaling.
investor_operator.interaction_model: Step-by-step assembly manual. Interactive logic blocks, 'under-the-hood' toggles that switch UI to raw JSON/terminal outputs.
investor_operator.visuals: Raw wireframes, exposed terminal components, dark mode IDE aesthetics.

customer_executive.thesis: Outcome / Authority / Risk / Rollout (Contextualized by Dept/Industry).
customer_executive.narrative: Enterprise Search answers board queries, Onyx unifies org silos, AIGIS provides oversight, Colanode aligns teams, DeerFlow executes autonomously.
customer_executive.interaction_model: ROI calculators, risk mitigation sliders. Top-down 'Command Center' feel. Approval workflow simulators.
customer_executive.visuals: Large singular metrics. Clean, sparse layout. 'Executive Summary' high-contrast blocks.

customer_technical.thesis: End-to-End Architecture / Data Flow / Security / Deployment.
customer_technical.narrative: BM25+Dense retrieval (Search), Connector ingestion (Onyx), LangGraph Postgres (AIGIS), CRDT local-first (Colanode), MCP Sandboxes (DeerFlow).
customer_technical.interaction_model: Inspectable architecture console. API payload inspectors, network topology live maps, mock trace logs.
customer_technical.visuals: Heavy use of IBM Plex Mono. 'Terminal' split-screens. Raw data streams.

customer_workflow.narrative: Search for context, Onyx for grounding, AIGIS human-in-loop, Colanode multiplayer, DeerFlow background agents running tasks.
customer_workflow.interaction_model: Interactive timeline of a workday. Split-screen collaboration views. 'Approve/Reject' live notification interactions.
customer_workflow.visuals: Chat-like interfaces mixed with Kanban/CRDT boards. Minimalist but dense with micro-interactions.

image_urls.description: As this is a pure monochrome brutalist implementation, avoid lifestyle photography. Use ASCII art, SVG diagrams, and pure data visualizations natively built. If logos/sponsors are strictly needed, use high-contrast white SVGs.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Swiss Brutalist, monochrome website.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards with rounded corners and soft shadows. Override Shadcn components to have `rounded-none border-white/20 border shadow-none bg-black`.
Use `framer-motion` to create staggered, sharp reveals of borders and grids on page load.

Ensure all 6 paths (/investor/venture, /investor/strategic, /investor/operator, /customer/executive, /customer/technical, /customer/workflow) have explicitly unique React components and DOM structures. DO NOT use a shared `<LayoutTemplate>` that just swaps props. They must feel structurally distinct.
For technical pages, implement a fake terminal effect or JSON payload inspector.
Integrate the 5 systems (Enterprise Search, Onyx, AIGIS, Colanode, DeerFlow) contextually in the text and visual proofs for EACH page, tailored to that persona's thesis.
DO NOT use generic AI emojis.
Use Radix UI primitives directly if Shadcn components are too opinionated to easily convert to pure brutalist.
Ensure `react-router-dom` or Next.js routing is set up correctly to direct URLs to these distinct pages.
Mobile layout must maintain brutalism. Stack grids, ensure typography clamp() functions don't overflow viewport.
No full-screen gradients. Use pure black #050505.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
